prereg.clause: section 3 common structure, closing receipts: forecast-recalibration receipt carries predicted vs measured step time, tokens/s, proxy-joules/token, peak VRAM, loss trajectory

applies_to.description: the next certified from-step-1 specialist run (R1 credited evidence root), image capability, ember-sparse-3b-v2, single RTX 4090 at vram_fraction 0.85, >= 100 contiguous steps

basis.run_root_note: the live-receipts custody root for that run_id; identified content-wise by the telemetry sha below, not by any host path
basis.series: 200 deduped train_step rows (steps 5..204, last occurrence per step) out of 1400 telemetry rows from 7 launch attempts
basis.statistic_population: every quantity below is computed on the DEDUPED last-occurrence-per-step series -- the exact statistic src/ember/governance/scripts/forecast_recalibration.py measures -- never on the raw 1400-row population (rev-1490 finding 5: mixing the two bases made the basis run miss its own band). Where the raw population informs a band edge, that is stated explicitly.
basis.adjudication_note: this continuation series was ruled non-credited for R1-E1/E2 (contiguous_from_step_1 false; issue #1464 adjudication 2026-08-06). It is used here solely as the measured basis for prediction, which is exactly what a prior run is for.

step_time_ms.unit: milliseconds per optimizer step, median of the deduped series
step_time_ms.method: deduped-series median 160.163 (n=200, deduped p10 158.3 / p90 163.55). Band widened asymmetrically outward: the raw 7-attempt population's p90 was 206.1 ms (cold attempts run slow, and a from-1 run starts cold), and a 5 percent fast tail is allowed below.

tokens_per_second.method: reproduces the generator's own fallback arithmetic on the basis run: tokens_seen 1546 / global_step 204 = 7.578 tokens/step, divided by the deduped median step time 0.160163 s = 47.32. For the from-1 run the generator divides by its own step count, and the record mix drawn from the same selection may shift tokens/step; the band covers the step-time band plus that mix variation. NOT comparable to 2048-token semantic-path benchmarks (656 and 1976 tok/s) - different path, different record shape.

proxy_joules_per_token.unit: joules per consumed token, DEGRADED_PROXY boundary
proxy_joules_per_token.method: no measured sample exists anywhere yet (energy_proxy_logger.py never invoked - battery E5 receipt 2026-08-05). Upper region: 450 W board TDP x 0.160163 s / 7.578 tokens = 9.51. Lower band edge: 35 percent mean-draw assumption at short-step utilization. First measured sample recalibrates this; the wide CI is the honest statement of ignorance.

peak_vram_gib.unit: GiB, peak used = total_gib minus minimum free_gib over the deduped series
peak_vram_gib.method: deduped-series statistic the generator computes: total_gib 23.988 minus deduped min free_gib 3.835 = 20.152 GiB used at vram_fraction 0.85; from-1 run shares shape, optimizer coverage, and batch construction. (The raw population's min free_gib is 3.553 -> 20.435 GiB; the band's upper half covers it.)

loss_trajectory.method: the deduped series' measured losses at the same absolute steps (its steps 5..204 sit on the same lineage schedule the from-1 run replays: the parent covered 1..4 and the canary's step-5 loss 6.93 equals ln-vocab random-init level, so the descent shape is expected to reproduce from step 1). CI widened to 0.5 because the from-1 run re-runs steps 1..4 under its own seed draw.

falsifiability_note: each quantity risks a wrong prediction: a from-1 run whose step time, throughput, VRAM, or loss anchors land outside these bands is a FORECAST-MISS to be recalibrated with receipts, never silently absorbed (prereg E-A / F-02 posture). Sanity check executed at authoring time: the basis run itself, re-measured by src/ember/governance/scripts/forecast_recalibration.py's own statistics, lands inside every band above (step_time 160.163, tokens/s 47.32, peak VRAM 20.152).
